integrity: The analytical proof and reproducible finite checks are supplied. Finite experimentation is not an infinite proof. The comparative literature review is qualified because highly relevant primary full text could not be accessed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed total, uniform multinomial cells, path adjacency, N/n tending to a positive finite constant; second-moment asymptotics only, no CLT or finite-sample bounds. Related exact finite-law algorithms may implicitly contain a corresponding limit.
title: Conditioning removes a leading variance term from multinomial histogram roughness
